newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's LUKoil says $200 mln bond oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Russia's LUKoil says $200 mln bond oversubscribed.

text.p: Russia's biggest oil company LUKoil said on Friday its $200 million convertible bond issue last week was oversubscribed.
LUKoil spokesman Pyotr Neyev told Reuters the official results of the five-year bond issue would be released in London on April 29.
The bonds become convertible into shares in 2002.

LUKoil made two issues of convertible bonds in 1995, which were mainly bought up by Atlantic Richfield Co (ARCO), a U.S. oil company, which as a result ended up with 7.99 percent of LUKoil. The two companies also have a $5 billion joint venture.
